summary: Create task with title and description
description: Verifies that a task is successfully created when both title and description are provided, and that the response includes a unique id, status=pending, and a non-null createdAt.

steps.action: Send a create task request
steps.expected_result: Response contains id (non-null, unique), title="Buy groceries", description="Milk, eggs, bread", status="pending", createdAt (non-null ISO 8601 timestamp)

steps.action: Send a second create task request
steps.expected_result: Response id differs from the first task's id

summary: Create task with title only (no description)
description: Verifies that a task can be created with only a title; description defaults to null or is omitted from the response.

steps.action: Send a create task request with title only
steps.expected_result: Task is created with id, title="Read a book", status="pending", createdAt present; description is null or absent

summary: Create task fails when title is missing
description: Verifies that submitting a create request without a title field returns a validation error and no task is persisted.

steps.action: Send a create task request without a title
steps.expected_result: Response is a validation error (e.g., 400 Bad Request); no task is stored

steps.action: List all tasks
steps.expected_result: The invalid task does not appear in the list

summary: Create task fails when title is an empty string
description: Verifies that an empty-string title is treated the same as a missing title and is rejected with a validation error.

steps.action: Send a create task request with an empty title
steps.expected_result: Response is a validation error; no task is persisted

summary: Create task ignores caller-supplied createdAt
description: Verifies that if a caller passes a createdAt value it is ignored and the server always assigns its own timestamp.

steps.action: Send a create task request including createdAt
steps.expected_result: Task is created; returned createdAt is the server-assigned time, not 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z

summary: List tasks returns all created tasks with full metadata
description: Verifies that the list endpoint returns every non-deleted task with id, title, description, status, and createdAt fields.

steps.action: Create two tasks
steps.expected_result: Both tasks are created successfully

steps.action: Call the list tasks endpoint
steps.expected_result: Response is an array containing both tasks; each object has id, title, description, status, and createdAt

summary: List tasks returns empty array when no tasks exist
description: Verifies that listing tasks on an empty store returns [] without an error.

steps.action: Ensure the task store is empty (fresh state or all tasks deleted)
steps.expected_result: Store contains no tasks

steps.action: Call the list tasks endpoint
steps.expected_result: Response is an empty array [] with a success status code (e.g., 200)

summary: Update task title
description: Verifies that updating the title of an existing task persists the change and returns the updated task object.

steps.action: Create a task
steps.expected_result: Task created; note returned id

steps.action: Send an update request for the task id with a new title
steps.expected_result: Response contains the task with title="Updated title"; all other fields unchanged

steps.action: List all tasks
steps.expected_result: The task appears with title="Updated title"

summary: Update task description
description: Verifies that updating the description of an existing task persists the change.

steps.action: Create a task without a description
steps.expected_result: Task created; description is null/absent

steps.action: Send an update request with a new description
steps.expected_result: Response contains description="Now has a description"

summary: Update task status from pending to completed
description: Verifies that a task status can be changed from pending to completed and the updated object is returned.

steps.action: Create a task
steps.expected_result: Task created with status="pending"

steps.action: Send an update request to change status
steps.expected_result: Response contains the task with status="completed"

summary: Update task status from completed back to pending
description: Verifies that a completed task can be reverted to pending.

steps.action: Create a task and update its status to completed
steps.expected_result: Task status is completed

steps.action: Send an update request to set status back to pending
steps.expected_result: Response contains the task with status="pending"

summary: Update task fails for non-existent id
description: Verifies that updating a task with an unknown id returns a 404-equivalent error and no data is modified.

steps.action: Send an update request with an id that does not exist
steps.expected_result: Response is a not-found error (e.g., 404); no task is created or modified

summary: Update task fails for invalid status value
description: Verifies that setting status to a value other than pending or completed is rejected with a validation error.

steps.action: Create a task
steps.expected_result: Task created with status="pending"

steps.action: Send an update request with an invalid status
steps.expected_result: Response is a validation error; task status remains "pending"

summary: Update task fails or no-ops when no fields are provided
description: Verifies that submitting an update request with an empty body returns an informative error or a no-op response rather than silently succeeding.

steps.action: Create a task
steps.expected_result: Task created

steps.action: Send an update request with an empty body
steps.expected_result: Response is either a validation error or an unchanged task with an informative message; no crash

summary: Update task does not change createdAt
description: Verifies that createdAt is immutable and cannot be overwritten via an update call.

steps.action: Create a task and note its createdAt value
steps.expected_result: Task created; record original createdAt

steps.action: Send an update request that includes a new createdAt
steps.expected_result: Response createdAt equals the original server-assigned value, not 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z

summary: Delete task with valid id
description: Verifies that a task is removed from the store after a delete request and no longer appears in the list.

steps.action: Create a task
steps.expected_result: Task created; note returned id

steps.action: Send a delete request for the task id
steps.data: id of the task just created
steps.expected_result: Response is a success confirmation or 204 No Content

steps.action: List all tasks
steps.expected_result: The deleted task is not present in the response

summary: Delete task fails gracefully for non-existent id
description: Verifies that deleting with an unknown id returns a graceful error and does not crash the system.

steps.action: Send a delete request with an id that does not exist
steps.expected_result: Response is a structured not-found error; system remains operational

summary: Delete task fails gracefully for malformed id
description: Verifies that a malformed or wrong-type id on a delete request returns a graceful error rather than an unhandled exception.

steps.action: Send a delete request with a malformed id
steps.data: id = null / undefined / special characters / extremely long string
steps.expected_result: Response is a structured error; no crash or unhandled exception

summary: Deleted task is excluded from list results
description: Verifies end-to-end that after deletion the list endpoint no longer returns the removed task while other tasks remain.

steps.action: Create two tasks
steps.expected_result: Both tasks exist; note their ids

steps.action: Delete the second task
steps.expected_result: Delete succeeds

steps.action: List all tasks
steps.expected_result: Only "Keep me" is present; "Remove me" is absent

summary: Task ids are unique across multiple creates
description: Verifies that each create operation produces a distinct id and no two tasks share the same id.

steps.action: Create five tasks in sequence
steps.expected_result: All five tasks are created successfully

steps.action: Collect the ids from all five responses
steps.expected_result: All five ids are distinct (no duplicates)

summary: Newly created task always has status pending
description: Verifies that the status field is always initialized to pending regardless of any status value passed on create.

steps.action: Create a task without specifying status
steps.expected_result: Returned task has status="pending"

steps.action: Attempt to create a task with status set to completed
steps.expected_result: Task is created with status="pending" (caller-supplied status ignored) OR a validation error is returned
